statement: The record identifies a 2014 carved elephant-ivory tusk imported from Cameroon in 2015; despite its “permitted” status, that provenance warrants holding the lot pending specialized legal and documentation review.
judge_text:
CAUTIOUS
It flags concern but only says the provenance "warrants holding the lot pending specialized legal and documentation review," without asserting the sale is illegal under the post-1976/ESA ivory ban.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
